pulls.title: Field Descriptors and repeatable CoAP options
pulls.author: marco-tiloca-sics
pulls.body:
This PR addresses two narrowly scoped points:

* Section 5.1 - A single Field Descriptor can pertain to multiple adjacent instances of the same CoAP option that are treated as grouped together (e.g., see Section 5.4).

* Section 5.4.1 - Handling a variable number of path segments and query parameters requires different SCHC Rules to cover the different possibilities. (E.g., a Uri-Path Option that is present and has no option value is **not** equivalent to an absent Uri-Path Option)

EDIT: More details at https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/msg/schc/uQ9E77-g0dsHsjbXWI63yaV8tdg/

pulls.title: Remove YANG module
pulls.author: marco-tiloca-sics
pulls.body:
This PR addresses the Yangdoctors review from Dhruv Dhody archived at https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/msg/schc/otF2zxf2yetfeYNbNjPd12zicF4/

In particular, it removes from the Internet Draft:

* Appendix A with the YANG module ietf-schc-coap.
* Section 12.1 with the short security considerations about the YANG module ietf-schc-coap.
* Sections 13.1 and 13.2 with IANA considerations about the YANG module ietf-schc-coap.
* The text in Section 13.4.2 about the ietf-schc module, in the IANA considerations about the new registry.
* The text in Section 4.3 instructing to have a reference to RFC 8974 for fid-coap-tkl in the ietf-schc module.
* The text in Section 4.6 instructing to have a reference to RFC 8974 for fid-coap-token in the ietf-schc module.
* The references to RFC 9363, RFC 3688, RFC 6020, and RFC 8407 as not needed anymore.


As to the YANG module in itself:

* It was anyway fixed according to the related comments in the Yangdoctors review (on top of those from Alexander's review archived at https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/msg/schc/1WufzPEaik4bEBso0hIe5ACi9Xc/ ).

  Corrections include the format of the copyright disclaimer, the new identity "fl-variable-bit" corresponding to the function length var_bit, and the fixed name of the identity "fl-oscore-piv-length" corresponding to the function length osc.piv.

* It is available on the GitHub at https://github.com/ietf-wg-schc/draft-ietf-schc-8824-update/blob/main/ietf-schc-coap%402026-06-30.yang
